query: select g.source_id,g.ra,g.dec,g.phot_g_mean_mag,g.bp_rp,g.ruwe,g.non_single_star,g.phot_variable_flag,v.in_vari_eclipsing_binary from gaiadr3.gaia_source g left outer join gaiadr3.vari_summary v on g.source_id=v.source_id where 1=CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS',g.ra,g.dec),CIRCLE('ICRS',319.637634540402,-51.4817180608647,0.0333333333333333))
